format: Standard UFO 3, packaged as UFOZ until make edit unpacks it
outline_compiler: ufo2ft (fontmake's compiler); no contour optimization or point removal
layout_source: Each UFO's data/com.overlyx.anodyne/tables.ttx contains editable GSUB, GPOS, GDEF, MATH and font metadata

bootstrap_repairs.scope: All 24 weight/width/grade corners of both styles
bootstrap_repairs.reason: An early bootstrap retained a refitted Regular even when its Bold correspondence failed the interpolation guard. Equal point counts hid different on/off-curve flags, so varLib skipped these glyph variations.
bootstrap_repairs.method: Retain the original Lisnoti Regular topology, use the canonical bounded outline-emboldening fallback, then regenerate condensed and grade drawings. Each repaired GLIF records the reason in its glyph lib.
bootstrap_repairs.canonical_generator: build.py now replaces Regular only after accepting a compatible fit; master compatibility is validated before varLib. Fresh preparation produces the same fallback construction. The tracked partial UFOs repair already prepared sources without repeating all contour matching.

provenance: source-lock.json pins every upstream binary and license. Noto native source locations are pinned there as design references.
design_status: Prepared Thin, Black and condensed Lisnoti additions are compatible bootstrap drawings derived by the generator. They are editable starting points, not a claim that every glyph has been independently redrawn or optically reviewed. Intentional reviewed drawings belong in tracked partial UFO overrides.
